name: EMOM — Dumbbell Base 20
description: Accessible full-body EMOM that builds repeatable muscular output without race-style modality integration.
coaching_notes: Choose loads that preserve 15-25s rest each minute. Do not chase failure.

name: EMOM — Lower Body 24
description: Lower-body muscular endurance using simple squat, lunge and step patterns with controlled clock pressure.
coaching_notes: Local leg fatigue is intended; movement breakdown is not. Scale reps before load.

name: EMOM — Upper Body 24
description: Push-pull upper-body endurance with enough rest to sustain quality across six cycles.
coaching_notes: Avoid early failure. Reps should remain within 1-3 reps of the opening round.

name: EMOM — Kettlebell Work Capacity 20
description: Kettlebell muscular endurance centered on repeatable ballistic and squat output.
coaching_notes: The clock creates repeatability, not urgency. Reduce reps if rest disappears.

name: EMOM — Bodyweight Density 24
description: Equipment-free muscular endurance with simple patterns and sustainable repetition.
coaching_notes: Leave reps in reserve every minute. Shorten the crawl or reduce reps before form degrades.

name: EMOM — Dumbbell Push-Pull 24
description: Repeatable dumbbell push-pull endurance with trunk and grip support.
coaching_notes: Do not turn this into a max-rep test. The final round should resemble the first.

name: EMOM — Squat + Carry 20
description: Simple loaded muscular endurance emphasizing legs, trunk and grip.
coaching_notes: Use moderate loads. Continuous high-quality accumulation is the target.

name: EMOM — Power Endurance 18
description: Shorter technical EMOM for athletes who can sustain power-oriented dumbbell work without losing mechanics.
coaching_notes: Power quality governs loading. This is muscular endurance, not a conditioning sprint.

name: Metcon — Dumbbell 5s
description: Full-body dumbbell metcon where local muscular fatigue, not running or transitions, is the primary limiter.
coaching_notes: Use one sustainable loading strategy. Avoid failure and keep round times within ~15%.

name: Metcon — 12-10-8-6
description: Descending-rep muscular endurance with simple loaded and bodyweight patterns.
coaching_notes: Break sets before failure. The ladder should feel progressively more sustainable, not frantic.

name: Metcon — Lower Body Chipper
description: Lower-body chipper built around accumulated squat, lunge and step volume rather than race integration.
coaching_notes: Use manageable chunks from the start. Do not save all breaks for late-stage failure.

name: Metcon — Upper Body Chipper
description: Upper-body push-pull volume challenge emphasizing sustainable muscular output.
coaching_notes: Submaximal chunks are the intended strategy. Keep shoulder mechanics clean.

name: Metcon — Kettlebell Ladder
description: Kettlebell ladder combining ballistic, squat and press endurance without cardio-machine dependence.
coaching_notes: Do not sacrifice ballistic mechanics to finish a rung unbroken.

name: Metcon — Bodyweight 20
description: Minimal-equipment muscular endurance using a repeatable bodyweight circuit.
coaching_notes: Score completed rounds plus reps, but pacing and repeatability take priority over speed.

name: Metcon — Dumbbell Complex Endurance

coaching_notes: Load for clean movement combinations, not maximal strength. Preserve the same movement standard each round.

name: Metcon — Carry Builder

coaching_notes: Carry posture and grip quality govern load. Avoid racing the transitions.

name: PIVOT Hero — Atlas

name: PIVOT Hero — Long Haul
description: High-volume benchmark designed to test sustained muscular output with minimal equipment.
coaching_notes: Plan breaks before failure. This is a volume benchmark, not a test of reckless unbroken sets.

name: PIVOT Hero — Iron Mile

coaching_notes: Maintain carry posture and repeatable chunks. Grip failure should not force unsafe movement.

name: PIVOT Hero — Anvil
description: Technical dumbbell benchmark combining integrated movements with foundational muscular endurance.
coaching_notes: Use a load that preserves integrated-movement quality for the entire benchmark.

name: PIVOT Hero — Groundwork
description: Equipment-free benchmark for repeatable bodyweight muscular endurance.
coaching_notes: Scale reps before movement quality changes. Retests should use the same scaling.

name: PIVOT Hero — Stronghold
description: Upper-body benchmark with sustained push, pull, grip and trunk output.
coaching_notes: Keep pushing and pulling volume balanced. Avoid muscular failure early.

name: PIVOT Hero — Redline
description: High-demand PIVOT benchmark for athletes with established dumbbell power-movement competency.
coaching_notes: Technical quality is the stop rule. This benchmark is not appropriate outside the athlete's technical-capacity envelope.
